project.name: Jarvis Navigation
project.description: A pathfinder and a path follower for a butler that has no navigator of its own: A* over block positions with walk, step, drop, jump, swim, climb and door moves, and a follower that turns a path into per-tick controls. It reads the world through its own small Terrain interface and depends on nothing but core's value types, so the Fabric spike compiles it from source and a Paper provider could use it too.
